display_name: Singapore child support — the SG Child Support Package and childcare leave
citation: SG Child Support Package and merged childcare leave, announced at the National Day Rally, 23 August 2026; Child Development Co-Savings Act 2001 (Singapore)
authority: Prime Minister's Office, Singapore; Ministry of Social and Family Development; Parliament of Singapore

source.note: THE FIRST SUBJECT IN THIS CORPUS WHOSE PRIMARY SOURCE IS NOT LAW. The SG Child Support Package was announced at the National Day Rally on 23 August 2026, to be implemented from 1 April 2027; as at the encoding date no Bill has been introduced and the Child Development Co-Savings Act 2001 — the statute under which the Baby Bonus Scheme, the Child Development Account and childcare leave all operate — is unamended. So the rule-version axis here does not carry two versions of one statute: its arms are the schemes AS ADMINISTERED TODAY and the scheme AS ANNOUNCED, and the encoding says which is which at every dated figure. The announcement is the 'current' source; the Act is the 'instrument', and reading the two against each other is what produced four of the nine forks. Full provenance in encodings/legalese/registers/source-bundle.json; re-run encodings/legalese/source/fetch.sh to reproduce the fetch.
